row.notes: Initialises a render bounds/culling node from AABB param_2 (min,max rows) and matrix param_3: logs 'odd dims - all zero on %s' (log channel ANDREW_WRIGHT) when the box has zero size, clamps extents to +-999999.0 (0x497423f0 / 0xc97423f0), sets flags byte +0x8f (4 when +0x8e&1 clear), computes derived centre/extent floats. Callers Game_Particles_CreateEffectNode, Ne_CrowdZoneInstance_Initialise, 0x143d3e970. Addon: a zero-size AABB on an effect or crowd zone prints a log line; bounds are clamped to 1e6.
